scope: Diagnostic profiles of existing binaries; hypothetical allocations are analytical only. No modified production prover benchmarked.
model_checks: All four reproduced current composed security values to absolute tolerance 1e-10 bits. All candidate allocations retain normalized error <=15/16 in the floating-point model. Exact-rational and protocol integration checks remain necessary before adoption.
limitations: Same input seed 42; repeated trials characterize timing, not nonce-distribution variability.
Instrumentation adds overhead; use original uninstrumented campaign for latency comparisons.
Opening work weight retains current source estimate; observed block counts are higher.
Initial-k survey does not preserve the fixed 16-lane opening geometry and is not a drop-in Falcon configuration.
Query tradeoff sweep includes prime groups in optimization; its 128-query-target case is the comparison baseline.
